description: Figure 7 presents a line plot comparing the performance of different query selection strategies on the dev set of MS-Marco, measured by MRR@10 on the y-axis, which ranges from 33.0 to 36.5 in linear increments, and the x-axis represents the “Number of queries used during inference (S)” ranging from 0 to 10. The plot includes eight distinct lines, each corresponding to a different query selection strategy: “DPR w/o query” (black solid line), “DPR w/ gold” (yellow solid line), “DPR w/ top-1” (green solid line), “DPR w/ bottom-1” (purple solid line), “DPR w/ random” (blue solid line), and “DPR w/ curriculum” (red solid line). Additionally, there are dotted lines of the same colors representing the “typical representation” for each strategy. The “DPR w/o query” line remains nearly flat at approximately 34.5 throughout the range. The “DPR w/ gold” line starts at 33.0 and rises to approximately 35.0. The “DPR w/ top-1” line begins at approximately 34.5 and increases steadily to about 36.5. The “DPR w/ bottom-1” line starts near 35.0 and declines slightly to around 34.5. The “DPR w/ random” line begins near 35.0 and remains relatively flat. The “DPR w/ curriculum” line starts at approximately 35.5 and increases slightly to about 36.0. The dotted lines follow similar trends but generally lie below the solid lines, indicating lower performance for the typical representation compared to corpus expansion.
